defaults.observable_range: Inherited v2v_obs.V2VConfig.range_m; no new sensing threshold

api.Config: Config(cadence_s=60, n_candidates=32, wm_samples=8, horizon_s=600, p_star=0.8). Cadence/candidate/sample counts and gate are configurable; samples must be >=2. Unregistered or shortened horizons are refused.
api.score_moves: score_moves(record, rng, *, rollout, calibration, config=None, calibrate=None, move_api=None) -> dict. Shared scoring API for T2B/dense teachers, independent of a simulator.
api.observation: record has ego_id, group, rows, time_s, commands, policy_residuals, policy_state; optional history, world_id, state_id, committed_offsets. Sensor rows use the existing warm_history whitelist and must be ego-local. Group contains ego and 1..4 observed CAVs. History is causal, ego-local, and ends at the current observation.
api.moves_dependency: Default lazy import tools.coopmwm.moves; calls candidates(obs_state, rng, n) and offsets(move, t), validates family against FAMILIES. Move supports members/family attributes or mapping keys. Generator must honor record['group']; no production move stub is installed.
api.calibration_dependency: Default lazy import tools.coopmwm.planner_calibration.calibrate_probability(p_raw, calibration) -> scalar in [0,1]. An explicit calibrate callable may adapt the T1C API. No raw/identity fallback exists; calibration=None, invalid probabilities, unavailable dependencies or bad WM output cannot open the gate.
api.rollout: Callable(record, actions, K, H) -> {action_id: K paired scalar costs or dicts containing team_delay}, using common future indices across all actions. Lower cost is better.
api.WMRollout: WMRollout(runtime, memory=None, chunk_actions=4) validates CPU model/policy parameters and calls existing plan_wm.evaluate with trim=False, final_chain=True and full H. Existing policy_wm actor continuation, WM samples, source priors, safety and command-chain machinery are reused.
api.selection: Explicit none comparator id='policy' continues the current MAPPO/base actor. p_raw is fraction of paired gains strictly >0 (ties do not win); expected_gain is the paired mean. Apply calibration, then choose greatest positive expected gain among candidates with calibrated P >= p_star, with stable ties. Output includes selected_move, selected_id, offset_profile, per-candidate scores, paired_gains, horizon_s and gate receipt.
api.OnlinePlanner: OnlinePlanner(*, rollout, calibration, rng, accel_bounds, config=None, calibrate=None, move_api=None, world_id=None). Supply a dedicated move RNG and inherited acceleration bounds with upper bound <=1.2; supply the caller's observable world identifier when required by the qualified WM runtime.
api.runtime_hook: v2v_runtime.controller_class(acceleration.Controller)(policy, generator, deterministic, planner_online=planner). Omitting planner_online, or passing None, is OFF. A concurrent guide, replay or branch request producer is refused.
api.execution: Every registered decision cadence re-evaluates all disjoint ego-local groups, replacing prior moves. A failed/rejected gate returns that group to base policy immediately. Between decisions, per-second offsets run to their own end; missing members or radio contact release the joint move. Full 600-second forecasts are never shortened to cadence, move duration or remaining execution time. Earlier groups' locally visible new offsets are identical background in both WM arms.
api.single_writer: Planner modifies only the existing pre-safety request map and sample action record; own_action remains the sampled base action. It never writes TraCI. Existing CommandOwnership remains the sole plant writer, with its safe speedMode 27 chain. HDVs cannot be move members or planner command recipients.
api.events: When enabled, sample['planner_online'] records decisions, paired scores, calibrated probabilities, failures, executed offsets and active group count. event['requests'] is the final request map. No planner event key is added when disabled.
